'Tanaporon', based on a short story by Rabindranath Tagore, directed by Abu Hayat Mahmud, will air on NTV at 11:10 pm.

'Daroga Shaheb Bishoy Ki', starring Zahid Hasan is a special 7-part tele-fiction which will be broadcast on ETV at 7:10 pm.

Bangla film 'Icecream', directed by Redoan Rony will be broadcast on Boishakhi TV at 11:45 pm today.
